# ankra_kubernetes_versions (Data Source)

The Kubernetes versions the platform supports for a distribution, to pin a cluster's `kubernetes_version`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster kubeadm-versions` and `ankra cluster k3s-versions`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_kubernetes_versions" "kubeadm" {
  distribution = "kubeadm"
}

output "stable_kubeadm_version" {
  value = data.ankra_kubernetes_versions.kubeadm.stable_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `distribution` (String) `kubeadm` or `k3s`.

### Read-Only

- `stable_version` (String) The version a cluster gets when it pins none; null when the catalogue names none.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Supported versions, newest first as the platform orders them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `channel` (String) Minor channel, e.g. `v1.33`.
- `published_at` (String) Publication time, when known.
- `version` (String) Version, e.g. `v1.33.4`.
